about: Which connected model is strongest, as the virtual engine auto ranks the owner's sources (sources/src/ranking.ts): tiers, strongest first, each a list of entries in order. An entry names a pi-ai provider id, or * for any, and a model id, exact or with * matching any run of characters, matched against the id and against its part after the last / (an aggregator's vendor/model). A model ranks at the first entry it matches; within one entry the newer id ranks first. Within a tier, a subscription's plan (ranked by the model its engine record says it runs) comes before any metered key, so a plan in the top tier wins over every key. A model no entry matches is unknown: it ranks after every tier, keys among the unknown by the score their source's vendor lists them at (a source record's listing), highest first, a scored one before an unscored one, then by their catalog output price, highest first, and auto tells the owner when it runs one. The platform changes this file by a reviewed change; nothing updates it on its own. An owner replaces it whole with /workspace/model-ranking.json, in this same shape.
